newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Mercosur union to hold contest for logo - diplomat.
newsitem.headline: Mercosur union to hold contest for logo - diplomat.

text.p: The four members of the Mercosur customs union in Latin America will hold a public competition for the bloc's first logo, a diplomatic source said on Monday.
The source said Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay were seeking a symbol similar to the European Union's blue flag and circle of stars representing the member states.
The source said they hoped to have a new logo ready by December, so it could be unveiled when heads of states of the Mercosur countries hold a summit in Brazil.

After years of talks, the union was formed in January 1995. It has made rapid progress, recently signing a free trade deal with Chile and striking an accord with Bolivia. It is now negotiating closer ties with other nations in the region.
Mercosur has also begun talks with the European Union about a possible trade deal.
